description: Notification settings page that is accessible except for one defect: the custom role="switch" toggles have tabindex, an accessible name, a description and aria-checked, but only a click handler, so keyboard users can focus a switch and never change it.

hard.note: The switches carry every ARIA attribute a reviewer checks first; the only defect is the missing Space/Enter handler in the script block

_calibration.note: Window modeled on a11y-color-only-signaling: one focused error-level pattern repeated on two controls
